summary: This Form 6-K reports board resignations. On August 5, 2026, director Yu-yun Tristan Kuo resigned from the Board and all committees, effective immediately. On August 12, 2026, director Chun Pong (Colman) Chiu also resigned from the Board and all committees, effective immediately. Both resigned voluntarily, with no disagreement regarding the Company's financial or accounting policies or operations. No replacements, compensation, or other terms are disclosed. The abrupt, voluntary nature of back-to-back board resignations without cause suggests potential governance changes. Watch for successor appointments or further departures, which could signal strategic shifts or operational issues.
